summary: Test suite for preview_nodes is comprehensive and behavioural. All 12 tests pass the litmus test (remove core logic line → test fails). Coverage spans both dispatch branches, parity with publish_article payload for flat and blocks paths, the offline invariant (no _api_call, no requests.post, no env), title-exclusion contract, edge cases (empty paragraphs, empty blocks falling back to flat), and unicode/emoji/HTML-entity passthrough.

tdd_anchor_coverage.test_title_not_in_nodes: covered (recursive walk asserts marker never appears)

extra_tests_added: test_empty_blocks_falls_back_to_flat — catches regression where empty blocks list takes the blocks branch
test_parity_with_publish_article_payload — integration-flavor check that publish_article uploads exactly preview_nodes output (flat path)
test_parity_with_publish_article_blocks_path — same parity check for blocks path
test_unicode_and_html_entity_passthrough — Cyrillic + emoji + HTML-entity-like text survives the node tree intact
